entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The allegations made in this writ petition are basically two fold.
Firstly, that no valid reason has been cited for rejecting the technical bid submitted by the petitioner.
Secondly, the respondent no. 5 has submitted self certified statement of experience but not from the competent authority whereas, the respondent no. 6 has not submitted the said documents at all.
Mr. Banik submits that the bids of the respondent nos. 5 and 6 were also liable to be rejected on technical grounds.

Since the petitioner's counsel has prayed for an interim order, I deem it appropriate to direct Mr. B.
Deuri, the learned Government Advocate, Assam, to obtain instruction responding to the allegations made by the petitioner.
Let this writ petition be listed for motion again on 09/09/2022.
Two extra copies of the writ petition be furnished to Mr. Deuri during the course of the day.
